fixes.explanation: Cities of refuge do come up in Moses' speech, friend (Deuteronomy 4:41–43), but this verse doesn't send a hard case there. Moses says you must go up to the place the LORD your God will choose, and then you go to the Levitical priests and the judge who presides at that time (Deuteronomy 17:8–9). Picture taking your hard case to the wrong building. You wait in line, get all the way to the window, and hear "wrong department." Check the address first, baker.

problems.problem: It has 6 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.
The claim that a city of refuge appears elsewhere in Moses' speech needs a reference. Deuteronomy 17:8–9 does not support it.
The drawer joke does not match the action in the comparison. Papa Dorin was put in a drawer, not sent to the wrong place after choosing an address.
